meta.title: Changelog — Aethyr
meta.description: Release notes for the Aethyr MCP server for Unreal Engine 5.

article.heading: Changelog
article.lead: What's in the Aethyr MCP server for Unreal Engine 5. Versions read 0.7.0-N, where N is the build number.

sections.heading: 0.7.0, October 2026
sections.html:
The first public release of Aethyr: an MCP server and editor plugin that lets your AI assistant read and author Unreal Engine 5 projects.

  • Versions. A version is 0.7.0-N, where N is the build number, the commit count of the build's commit. AethyrMcp.exe --version prints it, and the update check orders releases by N.
  • MCP server. AethyrMcp.exe is a standalone, engine-free server that speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, and over HTTP with a bearer token. It exposes the tool catalog in the reference. Progressive disclosure advertises a small core set first, and enable_tool_category or call_tool reaches the rest.
  • Editor plugin. AethyrEditor does Blueprint introspection and every write. AethyrRuntime reads UClass reflection and survives a cook. Both load on Unreal Engine 5.8 or later.
  • Backends. Calls go to a running editor when one is open and to a headless commandlet daemon otherwise. A running game build of the project is a second target: the editor stays the default, select_target switches after the user agrees, and served_by says who answered. A mock backend serves fixtures for client testing. Writes are on by default, and AETHYR_READ_ONLY=1 turns them off.
  • Atomic batches. apply_ops runs a batch with one compile and one save, and rolls the whole batch back when any op fails.
  • Engine Toolset Bridge. Epic's own ModelContextProtocol toolsets are reachable through epic_list_toolsets, epic_describe_toolset and epic_call_tool, with a read or write classification on every bridged call.
  • Setup and health. AethyrMcp.exe setup installs the plugin for one project. For Claude Code, Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot it writes the aethyr entry in <Project>/.mcp.json and the skills and agent in the project, and for the other clients and the guidance it writes to your profile. doctor and health_check report what is healthy and what is not.
  • Self-update. apply_update previews, verifies and swaps in a release, and rollback_update restores the previous one. The Fab build updates through Fab.
  • Skills and agent. Four aethyr-* skills and the aethyr-bp-audit agent ship with the plugin.
  • Sample content. install_samples builds a small set of sample assets from a text recipe.
  • Project-bound discovery. The server connects to, reuses, waits for or stops only an editor, daemon, game build or Epic server it can prove belongs to its own project. Anything else reads as nothing running, with a health_check note.
  • Game builds. A Development, DebugGame or Test game with the runtime listener on (AETHYR_RUNTIME_LISTEN=1) answers list_blueprints, read_blueprint, list_variables, get_components and get_function. Shipping builds carry no listener.
  • Graph layout. format_graph lays a Blueprint graph or a behavior tree out. A Blueprint graph gets exec flow left to right, pure nodes beside their consumers and comment boxes fitted. A behavior tree grows downward with every parent centred over its children, and it keeps the order the children run in: a layout that would change that order fails with execution_order_would_change and writes nothing. It is repeatable, supports dry_run, and is also an apply_ops op.
  • Widgets and structs. set_widget_property sets a widget's slot properties with Slot.<Name>, like Slot.Padding, and read_widget_blueprint reports each slot. create_struct takes members and makes the struct with exactly those members.
  • Name limits. A name or path of 1024 characters or more is refused before it reaches the engine, and names given to created things are capped at 128 characters.
  • Value validation. The shared value import refuses text that doesn't parse as the property's type instead of storing zero.
